long_biography.plain_text:
Fivex gave Joshua Berger a long-term platform for shaping commercial property in Sydney and Melbourne. As director, he focused on investment, development and management, favouring buildings that could be held and improved rather than treated as short-lived projects.

A Double Bay office and retail project brought that approach into sustainable design, harvesting rainwater, recycling wastewater and reducing energy use. In Melbourne, his acquisition of heritage-listed Carlow House reflected a parallel interest in restoring distinctive city buildings. Berger later founded the Fivex Art Prize, using large digital billboards to place contemporary work before audiences outside conventional galleries.
